description:
The data foundation for this already exists and was built specifically for it: T-018 ("Persona growth snapshots") added periodic PERSONA.md snapshots plus a structured growth summary (observation rate over time, ACTIVE pattern churn, session frequency trends, reinforcement counts, a "what Zug learned about you" narrative digest) with the explicit goal of being "dashboard-ready even if no UI exists yet." The `zug_growth_summary` MCP tool already surfaces this data.

The original OSS distribution design doc (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-24-zug-oss-distribution-design.md) scoped this as "Phase 3: Premium dashboard — growth visualizations, cross-session search, team workspaces" and explicitly excluded it from the OSS/local-first phase. It belongs in Commercialization: a paid-tier differentiator alongside sync, not something the free/local-only tier needs.

Scope: a web UI (served off the same account system as the landing page/signup) that answers the north star from T-018 — "what has Zug taught me about how I think?" and "is Zug getting better at working with me?" — via pattern emergence timelines, session/observation heatmaps, insight quality over time, and the narrative growth digest. Cross-session search is a stretch goal from the original Phase 3 framing, not required for v1.

Depends on T-045 (durable accounts) — a dashboard needs an authenticated user to scope data to. Gating (who can see it) follows from T-051 once that exists.

Relation: fulfills the "Phase 3" dashboard deferred in the 2026-05-24 OSS distribution design doc; consumes T-018's data model.
title: Web dashboard: growth visualizations from persona snapshot data (premium)
